text:
anna-support: Heads-up — customer 'Veridian' reporting p99 jumps from ~850ms -> 3.2s during their evening ingest window. Started ~10:20pm UTC.

mike-sre: Do we have an active Dedicated pool for them? any recent config changes?

anna-support: Yes, dedicated-pool-veridian-1. No config changes on their side AFAIK. They saw error 504s for a few requests but mostly slow responses. Logs attached (link).

jordan-platform: I see scale-up events around 22:20 but attach latency to the new GPUs is ~70-120s, and requests are queuing. looks like warmup is taking longer than usual.

lee-oncall: Can you paste the provisioning timestamps? e.g.: pool request -> instance ready -> attach accepted -> ready for traffic.

anna-support: Quick snippet from trace: ```
request queued at 2024-06-12T22:19:57Z
scaleup requested at 2024-06-12T22:20:03Z
gpu instance created at 2024-06-12T22:21:25Z
attach handshake at 2024-06-12T22:22:40Z
model load begin 22:22:42Z
ready for traffic 22:23:55Z
```

mike-sre: So ~3.5 minutes from scale request to ready. Our SLO target for dedicated cold starts is 90s. Something in the warmup path slowed down (image pull? model cache?).

jordan-platform: Checking pool metrics — node image pull times spiked. Registry responses show increased 500s briefly. Could be a transient registry slowdown causing delayed kernel image availability.

anna-support: Customer says this pattern repeats on heavy bursts — they do periodic batched requests at the top of the hour.

lee-oncall: Possible thundering-surge: many parallel attach requests caused the control-plane handoff to serialize and retry. Did autoscale burst policy allow many parallel attaches?

mike-sre: Their autoscale policy is 'aggressive' (max burst 12). When multiple attaches hit same host group, attach concurrency saturates the attach queue and triggers backoff. We also saw our attach-retry loop logging: ```WARN attach: handshake timeout, retrying (attempt=3)```

jordan-platform: Repro idea: simulate a 200-concurrent-burst against a small reserved pool and watch attach queue length + image pull latency. I can spin a test in staging.

anna-support: Customer wants mitigation now — they saw product outages. Any quick mitigations we can push for them?

mike-sre: Short-term options: 1) increase min pool size for veridian so fewer cold starts during bursts, 2) temporarily increase warm pool/prewarmed instances, 3) enable fallback routing to hosted infra for overflow (at cost). Which is acceptable?

anna-support: Veridian prefers to stay in Dedicated due to data residency, but they'll accept temporary fallback to hosted for non-sensitive routes. Also open to increasing min pool if cost-approved.

lee-oncall: I'm going to open an incident runbook entry for "scaleup handoff loop" and add a mitigation checklist: bump min_pool, throttle client burst (rate-limit), enable graceful fallback routing, and clear registry cache if necessary.

jordan-platform: For medium-term fix: we should add randomized attach backoff jitter and parallelize image pulls across registry endpoints. Also add early model load prefetch when scaleup is requested (start model stream to cache before attach completes).

mike-sre: Agreed. Also add an alert for "scaleup > 120s" to catch regressions before customer p99 spikes.

anna-support: I'll coordinate with customer on immediate fallback for non-sensitive routes and confirm cost approval for bumping min pool.

deploy-bot: Deploy: prod/staging/scaleup-warmup-jitter patch queued (PR #4312) — ETA 45m. :gear:

lee-oncall: Great — once PR lands, we should run the staged repro and notify Veridian if we see improvement. Thanks team :thumbsup:

mike-sre: Postmortem actions to track: (a) analyze registry 500s correlation with scaleup delays, (b) change attach backoff jitter, (c) add warm prefetch path, (d) better customer-facing guidance for burst patterns.

anna-support: Noted. I'll log this escalation and follow up with timeline and mitigations to the customer.

jordan-platform: Staging repro started — initial run shows attach latency down from 75s -> 28s with image-pull parallelization and jitter simulation. Will share traces.

anna-support: Thanks — please ping when you have traces so I can update Veridian.
